verdict.rationale: The MI355X is GPU hardware, but its first-party ecosystem includes fleet-management software (AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Device Metrics Exporter, Spur scheduler), and event-triggered automation such as health-based remediation is a plausible capability for that tooling, so the axis applies. None of the evidence documents user-definable rules that fire actions on events. The Prometheus metrics exporter only supplies building blocks that external alerting tools would have to act on, which earns no credit.
